notes: 7360A is Genelec's 10" (250mm) Smart Active Subwoofer (7300 series); floor-standing/flush-mountable enclosure, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Full connector-panel diagram and text confirmed from the official Genelec 7360A/7370A Operating Manual (Genelec Document D0134R001a), cross-checked against genelec.com/7360a technical specs (matching XLR counts: 7 analogue in, 7 analogue out, LFE in/out, AES/EBU in/out, 2x RJ45 GLM). AES/EBU ports use connector id "aes3" (signal type) though physically a 3-pin XLR shell; no bandwidth grade applies/was stated. GLM RJ45 ports carry a proprietary Genelec control protocol, not generic Ethernet, so no eth-* grade was assigned. Mains connector confirmed as a standard female IEC inlet from the panel diagram; the manual's text only specifies voltage (100-240 VAC 50/60Hz) without naming the exact IEC sub-type, so "iec" (C13/C14 family) is inferred rather than explicitly labeled - flagged as the one medium-confidence item in an otherwise high-confidence extraction.

ports.name: Analogue Output 1
ports.note: Doubles as OUT1/Test1 (85 Hz phase test tone) in standalone manual mode

ports.name: Analogue Output 2
ports.note: Doubles as OUT2/Test2, reserved for future use

ports.name: LFE In
ports.note: Dedicated LFE input, bandwidth extended to 150 Hz

ports.name: Link Out
ports.note: Summation of main inputs 1-7, passed to next daisy-chained subwoofer

ports.name: AES/EBU In
ports.note: XLR female, 110 ohm, AES/EBU single wire, 16-24 bit / 32-192 kHz

ports.name: AES/EBU Out
ports.note: XLR male, straight thru-put of AES/EBU In

ports.name: GLM Network 1
ports.note: Proprietary Genelec GLM control network over CAT5, not standard IP Ethernet - speed grade not applicable/stated

ports.name: GLM Network 2
ports.note: Second GLM network jack for daisy-chaining monitors/subwoofers

ports.name: Bypass
ports.note: Bass manager subwoofer bypass; accepts a TRS/TS contact open/close device (control, not audio signal)

ports.name: Mains Input
ports.note: 100-240 VAC 50/60Hz; standard IEC inlet visible in connector-panel diagram, exact C-type (C13/C14) not explicitly stated in text
